tools.name: find_shop_vouchers
tools.description: Looks up the currently valid voucher codes and offers for one online shop in Switzerland, Germany or Austria, using the live data of rabatt.codes (supplied directly by the shops, updated several times a day). Use it when the user asks whether a coupon, promo code or discount exists for a named shop.

tools.name: buy_now_or_wait
tools.description: Tells whether a promotion is expected soon. With a shop: what is valid now and the next promotion, labelled as announced by the shop or estimated from its past rhythm. Without a shop: announced and estimated promotions across shops in that country. Use it when the user asks whether to buy now or wai

tools.name: top_vouchers
tools.description: Lists the currently valid vouchers and offers with the highest discounts in one country, optionally within one category (for example fashion, electronics, travel, beauty).
